title: A second clock watches the queue from outside Vercel, so a stopped scheduler pages someone

source.ref: AUD-3 in the 2026-11-02 systems audit; Daniel asked for every recommendation built 2026-11-02

detail: GET /api/status/queue-lag reports how long the oldest due queued job has waited (503 past 15 minutes or when the read fails). The queue-watch GitHub workflow reads it every 20 minutes on GitHub's scheduler; a red run is emailed. It only reads, so it never competes with Vercel Cron. Runbook section updated.

verify.evidence: Route, test and workflow are present; the route test pins 200 inside the window and 503 past it or on a failed read.
